notes: Ranked replay verification uses its reviewed engine, independently of the game renderer. The live standings are unchanged.

entries.title: Ranked snapshot workflow repairs
notes: Maintenance update for ranked snapshot publishing and replay verification.

entries.title: Keep regression coverage for pending canonical retention
Keep exact canonical pending results without granting proof
Pin the offline engine independently of the released renderer
Polish Extra Tracks browsing
notes: Builder Program now opens in a centered popup and returns focus to More when dismissed.
Random and Quick Pick sit together, and Export My Picks is easier to spot.
Featured Picks show a compact track card with a square preview.

entries.title: Center the first-launch update notice
notes: Release notes appear centered on first launch while the game starts in the background.
Dismiss the notice once to skip it until the next release.

entries.title: Speed up game startup and add save-safe Retry
notes: The game reaches Play faster on startup and refresh.
The installed update notice no longer blocks the game.
GitHub Pages offers a save-safe Retry if a startup script fails. Google Sites may require reloading the page.

entries.title: Restore time at rank
notes: Overall Rankings shows how long a racer has held their saved position again.
Top % keeps last-place finishes below other ranked results and shows shorter percentages.

entries.title: Align Track Breakdown on tablets
notes: Track Breakdown keeps all six sorting options in one row and aligns results on tablets and Chromebooks.

entries.title: Verify saved replays by track
notes: Sort profile results by Top % from the same row as the other sort options.
Active playtime now shows a shorter hover label with the total in hours.
Replay verification can continue when a different track reaches its comparison limit.

entries.title: Refresh ranked leaderboards
notes: Ranked leaderboards now include newly saved race times.
Corrected Rolling Hills Racer event standings so verified Event RP matches the replay.

entries.title: Sync public ranked snapshots
Find and open tracks by keyboard
notes: Find Community Tracks by typing a name or RHR, then press Enter. Use 1-9 to open a track, ? to pick from this list, or ! to pick from all loaded tracks.
Switch Community versions with Shift+Left or Shift+Right. Discovery has a quick keyboard tutorial.

entries.title: Sort track results by Top %
notes: Sort Track Breakdown by Top % to compare your best finishes across fields of different sizes.

entries.title: Improve landscape rankings and track previews
notes: Rankings show more rows in landscape. The More button on compact rankings now explains what it opens to screen readers.
Track previews can warm again after a temporary failure, without hammering the connection.

entries.title: Preserve event standings during normal replay verification
notes: Improved Summer One replay verification so it can update without changing other event standings.

entries.title: Show your saved Workshop styles immediately
notes: Your saved Workshop changes show up on your car previews right away, even before the next rankings update.

entries.title: Show saved Workshop styles on ranked car previews
notes: Save your Workshop setup to show it on your car in Ranked Racers and racer profiles after the next snapshot.

entries.title: Fix Achievements and Style Shop loading
notes: Fixed Achievements and the Style Shop not opening after an update.
Paid styles in Racer Studio now open their exact Shop listing. The live preview leaves more room for your racer details.

entries.title: Expand achievements and the Style Shop
notes: Achievements now show 44 tiers, including new rewards for Ranked Extra finishes, personal bests, and verified wins. The Style Shop has eight new items, and live previews have more room.
